topic: Ice vs heat: when to use which
caption:
Ice or heat — which one? 🧊🔥
Fresh, swollen, warm injuries often feel better with ice; ongoing stiffness usually prefers heat.

Keep it to 15–20 minutes, wrap it in a towel, and take extra care over areas with reduced sensation.
